name: MarineSpecimenMeasurement
description: A total-length measurement taken from a marine biology specimen. Demonstrates the concepts keyword on both a type definition and properties, covering all seven kind values of the closed enumeration: owl-class and rdfs-class on the type, and rdf-property, dcterms-property, owl-object-property, owl-datatype-property, and skos-concept on properties. Also illustrates that skos-concept may appear alongside a property kind in one array.

specimenId.description: Unique identifier assigned to the specimen at the time of collection.

scientificName.description: Accepted scientific name of the taxon to which this specimen belongs, following the applicable nomenclature code.

collectedBy.description: URI of the person or organisation responsible for collecting the specimen.

totalLength.description: Total length of the specimen measured from snout tip to end of caudal fin.

collectedAt.description: Time at which the specimen was collected from the water.

recordedAt.description: Time at which the length measurement was entered into the laboratory record system.
